description: This file defines various asymmetric matchers used in Jest testing framework, including classes like Any, Anything, ArrayContaining, ObjectContaining, StringContaining, StringMatching, and CloseTo, along with their associated factory functions.

classes.name: AsymmetricMatcher
classes.description: Abstract base class for asymmetric matchers in Jest, implementing common context retrieval and interface.

classes.name: Any
classes.description: Matcher that checks if a value is of a specific type or constructor.

classes.name: Anything
classes.description: Matcher that matches any non-null and non-undefined value.

classes.name: ArrayContaining
classes.description: Matcher that checks if an array contains certain elements.

classes.name: ObjectContaining
classes.description: Matcher that checks if an object contains specific key-value pairs.

classes.name: StringContaining
classes.description: Matcher that checks if a string contains a substring.

classes.name: StringMatching
classes.description: Matcher that checks if a string matches a regular expression.

classes.name: CloseTo
classes.description: Matcher that checks if a number is close to an expected value within a specified precision.

methods.name: fnNameFor
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a function, handling anonymous functions.

methods.name: hasProperty
methods.description: Checks if an object or its prototype chain has a specific property.
